findings.description: A session that took a `pup fix` round (decision 90) has that round's gate runs counted as Re-gates and its `respawn {delivered}` marker counted as a Respawn. Neither a decision-86 re-gate nor a crash respawn happened, so ADR 0166's claim that decision 86 is the only source of post-merge gate runs does not hold. Either say so in the ADR, or count a re-gate only on merged→merged/refusal outside an open fix round.

`firstSentence` runs after `sanitizeReason` has already turned newlines into spaces and cut the goal at 300 chars. So `"Tasks sheet\nRead the backlog. Chart gates."` shows as "Tasks sheet Read the backlog.", and a long first sentence is cut mid-word with no marker. Split on sentence end or newline on the raw goal, then scrub.

A backlog task with no scope-in globs (e.g. a torn spec that ADR 166 degrades to "no scope") prints a bare `scope: ` with nothing after it, while the goal line on the same card falls back to `(no goal recorded)`. A parallel `(none recorded)` fallback would match.

`const WEEK_MS = 7 * DAY_MS` duplicates the identical constant in web-dashboard-overview.service.ts:39, and both sheets bucket weeks with it. Moving it beside `DAY_MS` in web-dashboard-sheet.utils.ts keeps the two from drifting (general.md §No hardcoded values).

The Hardening paragraph lists each render's work as one events query, one backlog query and one listing. It omits the live-sessions query that `backlogOverlaps` (web-dashboard-tasks.service.ts:249-264) also runs, so a reader counting per-poll queries comes up one short.

The comment "A bare transition, or a block after a rejection, is not a gate run." restates what the `PrSession.gates` JSDoc and ADR 0166's Gate runs paragraph already say (AGENTS.md §Comments: delete WHY duplicates of the seam's docs).
The `BacklogTask` JSDoc ("every string through `sanitizeReason` and `displayText`") repeats the mechanics `storeText` already documents at line 92 instead of stating the interface's contract.
The `renderTasksSheet` JSDoc re-lists the sheet's three sections, which `readTasksSheet`'s JSDoc (lines 108-113) and ADR 0166 already list. Only the "(decision 166)" pointer adds anything.
